description: Dynamic fertilizer recommendation rules. Thresholds are in kg/ha (or sensor-equivalent units). Edit this file to change behavior without touching code.

messages.no_deficiency: Soil nutrient levels are adequate for {crop}. No additional fertilizer required at this stage.
messages.deficiency: {crop} field shows a {severity} deficiency of {nutrient} ({current} vs recommended {optimal}). Apply approximately {quantity_kg_per_ha} kg/ha of {source} ({basis}).
messages.excess: {nutrient} level for {crop} is higher than recommended ({current} vs {optimal}). Avoid further {nutrient}-based fertilizer application to prevent nutrient burn or runoff.

ph_rules.description: Soil pH affects how available N/P/K already are to the plant, independent of the raw NPK levels. acidic_below and alkaline_above are on the standard 0-14 pH scale.

messages.too_acidic: Soil pH for {crop} is {ph}, which is acidic (below optimal range {min}-{max}). Nutrient uptake may be reduced even with adequate NPK levels. Consider applying agricultural lime to raise pH.
messages.too_alkaline: Soil pH for {crop} is {ph}, which is alkaline (above optimal range {min}-{max}). Consider applying elemental sulfur or organic matter to lower pH and improve nutrient availability.
messages.optimal: Soil pH for {crop} is {ph}, within the optimal range ({min}-{max}).
